funding.supported_assets_note: Stablecoin-funded Visa card inside Jupiter Spend (Jupiter Mobile app): USDC and USDT deposited to a Spend/Card balance shown in USD. Rain-issued cards: 'USDC and USDT are credited 1:1' and deposits 'stay on-chain as collateral for the card'. DCS-issued cards: USDC credited 1:1, USDT 'converted to USD by the issuer at market rate'. Other tokens/networks are swapped via Jupiter Mobile (0.1–0.2% swap fee) or Universal Deposit. 'Jupiter does not issue credit lines: you can only spend what you have deposited.' The docs say Jupiter 'does not take custody of your DeFi wallet funds' while DCS balances 'are handled by the partners'.

United States: only the 34 states listed in the support article (AL, AK, AR, CA, CO, CT, FL, HI, IL, IN, IA, KS, KY, ME, MA, MI, MN, MS, MO, MT, NE, NH, NJ, NY, NC, OK, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WV, WY). Physical cards 'rolling out in phases', full rollout 'planned by the end of 2026'.

kyc.stages_note: Account creation: Global ID (email, Google or Apple sign-in). Before any Spend/Card use: identity verification in five steps — identity document, phone number, liveness check, personal information, short questionnaire; provider SumSub ('All verification data is handled by SumSub'). Usually a few minutes; manual review 3–5 working days. The issuer (Rain/DCS) is assigned at KYC from the country of residence.

4% with a $200 monthly cap for one calendar month after referring 'at least 2 qualifying people during the previous calendar month' (a qualifying referral completes KYC and spends at least $50 on their Jupiter Card). Referring one person does not unlock it.

editorial.summary: Stablecoin-funded Visa card inside the Jupiter Mobile app (Solana), issued by Rain or DCS depending on the country of residence, with a USD balance credited 1:1 from USDC/USDT. No annual fee, no fee on USD payments, 1% (Rain) or 1.8% (DCS) on other currencies, 2% cashback in USDC capped at $100 a month (4% / $200 after two qualifying referrals). Available in about 50 countries across Latin America, Africa, the Middle East and Asia-Pacific plus 34 US states; not offered in the EEA or UK on any official page read. Physical cards are rolling out through 2026; ATM withdrawals only on Rain physical cards.
good_for: Residents of Latin America, Africa, the Middle East and Asia-Pacific who hold USDC/USDT on Solana and want a no-annual-fee USD Visa card
USD spending from stablecoins with 2% cashback (capped at $100 a month)
Apple Pay / Google Pay users in supported countries
not_for: Residents of the EEA, UK or Switzerland — not listed on any official page read
US residents outside the 34 listed states
Cash withdrawals in DCS countries (Australia, Japan, Malaysia, Philippines, Singapore, South Korea, Taiwan, Thailand, Vietnam) — not available
watch_outs: The card issuer depends on your country (Rain or DCS) and changes FX fee, limits and ATM access; the legal entities behind 'Rain' and 'DCS' are not named on the pages read.
The only official country list sits in an undated support article whose other statements (digital-only, USDC-only) are outdated versus the docs — second read needed.
Cashback is capped at $100 a month (2%) and the 4% rate depends on referring two new users every month.
Rain-issued card deposits 'stay on-chain as collateral'; refunds on Rain cards can be spent but not withdrawn; DCS cards cannot withdraw balances yet.
The standard virtual card's issuance price is not stated; the physical card costs $13.13 plus unstated shipping; card orders are non-refundable.
Full identity verification (SumSub) before any card use; proof of address in APAC.
